name: cfg-speed-mapping-edges
about: speed 偏好的边界与校验（cfg-provider-capabilities 已覆盖 speed=1 / 0.2 与不支持的模型）。gateway/dialog/modelCatalog.ts:68-84 validateExplicitModelSelection：speed 不是有限数或不在 [0,1] → UNSUPPORTED_MODEL_PARAMETER「speed must be between 0 and 1.」；model/request/speedMapping.ts:7-15 阈值 speed>=0.5 才映射成 priority / fast；providers/openai/request.ts:87-89、anthropic/request.ts:117-119、streamModel.ts:831 fast 的 beta 头。e1–e4：submit_turn 的 modelOverride 带 speed 0.5、0.49、0、1.5；e5：负数；e6：字符串 "1"；e7：session_model_set 带 speed 0.5，下一轮不带 override 时请求是否带 service_tier，session_model_get 回显；e8：session_model_set speed=2；e9：Anthropic speed=0.5 → speed fast 与 anthropic-beta 头。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
    oaism:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/oaism/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      speedMapping: openai_service_tier
      models:
        fast:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
            supportsSpeed: true
    anth:
      protocol: anthropic
      url: {MOCK}/anth
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      speedMapping: anthropic_speed
      models:
        fast:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
            supportsSpeed: true
telemetry:
  enabled: false
